title: Reform’s Tice says people should stop fighting climate crisis and ‘enjoy’ heat

paragraphs.en: Reform’s deputy leader has dismissed efforts to tackle climate breakdown as futile, as he urged British people to “enjoy” the warmth of the recent heatwaves.
paragraphs.zh: 英国改革党副领袖将应对气候崩溃的努力斥为徒劳，同时敦促英国人“享受”近期热浪带来的温暖。

paragraphs.en: Richard Tice told a press conference on Monday he believed it was “arrogant” to try to stop the climate emergency and added that politicians should focus instead on adaptation efforts, while encouraging people to focus on upsides such as better English wine.
paragraphs.zh: 理查德·泰斯周一在新闻发布会上表示，他认为试图阻止气候紧急状况是“傲慢的”，并补充说，政界人士应将重点转向适应气候变化的工作，同时鼓励人们关注诸如英国葡萄酒品质提升等积极方面。

paragraphs.en: Tice was speaking after a record-breaking summer during which temperatures have risen above 35C several times, causing thousands of deaths, millions of hospital visits and costing the UK an estimated £4bn in economic output.
paragraphs.zh: 泰斯发表这番言论之际，英国刚经历了一个破纪录的夏天，期间气温多次突破35摄氏度，造成数千人死亡、数百万人次就医，并使英国经济损失约40亿英镑的产出。

paragraphs.en: Related: ‘I couldn’t breathe’: the deadly health burden of wildfire smoke
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：“我喘不过气来”：山火烟雾造成的致命健康负担

paragraphs.en: The climate breakdown has been linked to the increasing frequency of wildfires , which are burning larger areas across many parts of the world. The so-called firewave the UK witnessed weeks ago was the most widespread the country has seen, with the combination of wet winters and prolonged heatwaves exacerbating the risk.
paragraphs.zh: 气候崩溃与山火日益频发有关，山火正在世界许多地方烧毁更大面积的区域。几周前英国遭遇的所谓“火浪”是该国有史以来波及范围最广的一次，潮湿的冬季与持续的热浪叠加，加剧了风险。

paragraphs.en: The National Farmers’ Union has said farmers are facing “one of the worst ever” harvests, while firefighters have battled wildfires in Derbyshire, the Midlands, Wales and Northern Ireland.
paragraphs.zh: 全国农民联合会表示，农民正面临“有史以来最糟糕的收成之一”，而消防员已在德比郡、英格兰中部、威尔士和北爱尔兰与山火搏斗。

paragraphs.en: Asked for his response to the extreme heat events, Tice told a press conference: “Of course, the climate changes, but where is the evidence that net zero is going to stop it? Where is the evidence? There is no evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 当被问及对极端高温事件的看法时，泰斯在新闻发布会上说：“当然，气候是在变化的，但哪里有证据表明净零排放能阻止它？证据在哪里？没有证据。”

paragraphs.en: “Climate change has always happened. It always will. Maybe the smarter thing to do is to adapt to it than think arrogantly that you can stop it.”
paragraphs.zh: “气候变化一直都在发生，将来也总会发生。也许更明智的做法是适应它，而不是傲慢地以为你能阻止它。”
